content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents, then read_document on candidate_specs.md and any detector/gas-requirements documents that appear relevant. Extract the three allowed candidate mixtures, assign numeric IDs 1-3 in the order listed in candidate_specs.md, and extract each candidate's GWP100 and any documented guidance on gas gaps or timing."},{"id":"s2","description":"Apply the hard environmental cut: keep only candidate mixtures with GWP100 <= 150 and exclude all others from further consideration. Record numeric values for each candidate ID, its GWP100, and an eligibility flag using record_results."},{"id":"s3","description":"For every eligible mixture, run simulate_time_resolution at gas gaps 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, and 3.0 mm. Record each numeric result with mixture ID, gap, and time resolution. Do not simulate or consider ineligible mixtures."},{"id":"s4","description":"Identify the best coarse result, then refine the gap scan for the best eligible mixture and any other eligible mixture within 10% of the best coarse time resolution. For each selected mixture, simulate gaps in 0.1 mm steps over max(1.0, best_coarse_gap - 0.5) to min(3.0, best_coarse_gap + 0.5). Record all gap and time-resolution results."},{"id":"s5","description":"Select the eligible mixture and gas gap with the lowest simulated time resolution among all recorded simulations, respecting the 1-3 mm gap bound. Record the final numeric recommendation: mixture ID, gas gap in mm, simulated time resolution in ns, and GWP100 for the chosen mixture."}]}
